newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Clariant sees double-digit '96 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Clariant sees double-digit '96 profit rise.

text.p: Swiss chemicals group Clariant AG said it expected a double-digit percentage increase in group net profit this year against 1995's net profit of 106 million Swiss francs.
Clariant said in its interim report it was confident about reaching its goals for the current year.
"Barring unforeseen events, especially regarding currencies, we expect a double-digit increase in group net profit for the entire 1996 year," Clariant said.
The confidence is based on the satisfactory development of sales, leading to another significant rise in July sales, and the continued positive effects of restructuring.
It added that the strategical new orientation that was begun in the spring continued to progress rapidly according to plans.
